snippet.title: Keep Driving - Steam Workshop & Console Release Date
snippet.description:
Keep Driving, our road trip management RPG, heads to Switch, PS5, and Xbox Series on September 28!

Originally launched last year, Keep Driving now heads to consoles alongside the PC version’s modding support update on September 28th. These upcoming ports include all previously released Steam updates, which included expanded localization support and new content.

It’s the early 2000’s, and you’ve just bought your first car. A long, slow summer lies ahead. Hearing about a festival on the other side of the country, you fire up your engine, plot a course on your map, and hit the road. How, if you get there at all, is up to you.

Take it easy. You have time.

Song: Leda by Makthaverskan
Check out the full soundtrack on Spotify playlists. 

PS thank you to all our players on Steam so far!!!
